name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceMultipleRewardReservedActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user tries to leave before finishing an experience reward. It offers a short additional tryout period to keep the reward available.
disableEffect: The ad's continue-to-earn reward prompt will no longer appear, and the reward cannot be claimed through it.
